title: Campaign Compass: answers you can inspect
body:
Who this helps

A marketer checking fictional product, policy and campaign facts before drafting copy.

What this video shows

A replay of genuine saved live outputs, their source passages, and the failures we kept. No provider requests occur during this recording.
caption: Week 1 dashboard reused; Week 2 adds retrieval and cited Q&A. Captioned walkthrough; no narration.

title: From source documents to a cited answer
body:
Prepare the evidence

28 original synthetic documents → normalize whitespace → heading-aware chunks: up to 180 words, with 30-word overlap. 119 chunks retain source lines, versions and hashes.

Ask a question

Pinecone integrated embeddings → existing vector index → semantic + local keyword passages → bounded context → Claude → citation checks → source inspection.
caption: Refresh is explicit: changed documents require re-ingestion and matching vectors. No real customer data.

title: Same question, different evidence
body:
Without retrieval — saved live summary

No reliable product specifications supplied; declined to confirm waterproofing.

Insufficient evidence

With retrieval — saved live answer summary

No. The Dayline pack may not be described as waterproof; its shell resists light splashes but is not waterproof.

Cited answer
caption: Question: Can the Dayline pack be called waterproof?
source: 2026-10-19 13:51 UTC • contemporaneous UI transcription; comparison summaries, not raw response text

title: Inspect the support, not just the answer
body:
Product specification

The shell resists light splashes but is not waterproof.

pack · Care and price · lines 6–6

Saved retrieval score: 0.5811

Claims policy

The Dayline pack may be described as resisting light splashes, with the limitation that it is not waterproof.

claims · Approved and prohibited claims

Saved retrieval score: 0.5260
caption: Scores measure similarity, not truth. Quote matching establishes text presence; meaning still needs review.
source: Source excerpts supporting the retained waterproof comparison

title: Recover a missing product detail
body:
Saved live question and answer

Does Ridgeline have a padded electronics compartment?

No. The Ridgeline tote has no padded electronics compartment (and no closure); it has a cotton canvas body and fixed cotton handles.

Supplied source passage

The tote has a cotton canvas body and fixed cotton handles. It has no closure or padded electronics compartment.
tote · Materials · lines 8–8 · active
caption: The original semantic search missed Materials. Bounded local keyword coverage now supplies it.

title: Explain current and historical versions
body:
Current: 18 liters

The current Dayline pack capacity is 18 liters, per the active pack specification.

The fictional Dayline pack has an 18-liter capacity and weighs 540 grams.
pack · Capacity and fit · lines 4–4 · active

Historical: 16 liters

ARCHIVED: Dayline v1 listed 16 liters during the fictional 2025 pilot. This document was superseded by the active Dayline specification. Do not use 16 liters for the current 18-liter product.
dayline-v1 · Historical capacity · lines 5–5 · superseded
caption: Linked archives explain an old value; they cannot establish a current claim. Explicit source filters remain authoritative.
source: K28 • saved live follow-up; active and superseded sources remain distinct

title: Ask when the question is underspecified
body:
Question

Which bag fits my device?

A bag’s nominal capacity or a device’s screen size does not establish physical fit.

Actual saved clarification

What device do you want to carry, and what are its physical length, width and thickness (with units)? Also, how do you plan to carry it, and does it need padding or protection?
caption: This clarification came from the live model. It needed no local completion and makes no claim that a device fits.

title: Show calculation inputs and policy
body:
Actual saved answer

Does an eligible 80 demo USD subtotal qualify for free shipping after EVERYDAY10?

Calculation: an eligible 80 demo USD subtotal minus 10 percent (8 demo USD) equals 72 demo USD. Because 72 is below the 75 demo USD threshold, standard shipping is not free, so the standard 6 demo USD shipping charge applies.

Supporting calculation example

An eligible merchandise subtotal of 80 demo USD becomes 72 after a 10 percent discount. Because 72 is below the active 75 threshold, standard shipping is not free.
offer-examples · Threshold arithmetic · lines 8–8 · active
caption: The question assumes an eligible subtotal. Arithmetic and the shipping rule are both grounded in supplied evidence.
source: K22 • saved live follow-up; earlier baseline validation failure remains recorded

title: Keep the failures visible
body:
Five complete outcomes

K17: tote materials K24: device clarification K28: current versus archived capacity K29: current versus expired shipping rule K22: discount and shipping calculation

Two answers rejected

K08 and K30 failed citation validation. K08 had all expected evidence. K30 still lacked the supersession section. Exact offending fields were not retained; root cause remains uncertain.
caption: Not an all-pass result. We did not retry, weaken citation checks, or identify formatting as the established cause.
source: Seven approved development cases • 7 searches + 7 generations; no reupload

title: What the results establish—and what they do not
body:
Practical checks

14 accepted claims in the follow-up had supporting quotes. Five of seven development outcomes were complete. The full original 30-question run remains preserved, including every failure.

Limits

These cases guided the fixes; they do not prove unseen accuracy. Pipeline median: 6.93 s; maximum: 11.79 s. Browser overhead excluded. A sub-10-second experience is not established.
caption: No new provider calls in this video. The saved comparison and follow-up used Claude + Pinecone; offline tests used mocks.

title: A bounded, inspectable RAG demonstration
body:
Delivered

Reused interface, auditable synthetic corpus, vector retrieval plus keyword coverage, cited answers, source inspection, clarification and explicit failures.

Next work

Diagnose K08/K30 citation rejections without guessing their root cause. Broaden practical question checks. Keep human review before using generated campaign claims.
caption: Local submission artifacts only. Public uploads, GitHub push and form submission remain paused.
